source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole board (board_source.py / board.json rule)
activation_note: INERT until LAS-160 approves a reservation program. Links render plain with first-party UTM (utm_campaign=EXP-0103); no affiliate id is applied while every network in affiliate_config.json is disabled with a placeholder id. Flipping a network enabled=true with a real id there (or via its env var) activates the affiliate wrap on this rail with no code change. Caveat: an Eventbrite listing that already carries its own aff= search tag will not be overridden by our Eventbrite id (affiliate._add_params never clobbers an existing param); resolving that is an LAS-160 activation decision.
methodology: A window is listed only when its own crawl-captured link (booking_url, else source_url) lands on a recognised reservation/ticket platform, the crawl verified it (not needs_confirm), and it carries a real parseable close date that has not passed. No dead or invented links; an empty week is honest. Sorted soonest-closing first.

items.title: Champagne and Caviar
items.blurb: A one-evening pairing of champagne and caviar, for a Friday that does not involve a costume. Sales are ending soon.

items.title: Friday Pre-Halloween Party Pass Crawl
items.blurb: A party pass crawl that warms up Halloween weekend a night early. The listing says sales are ending soon.

items.title: Nightmares from Poe
items.blurb: Edgar Allan Poe stories staged late on the Friday before Halloween, which is the right hour for them. Tickets from $49.

items.title: The Hex Hotel | Halloween at Virgin Hotels Nashville
items.blurb: A Halloween night hosted inside a hotel, free to attend with a ticket reservation. A Friday evening start puts it just ahead of the actual Halloween weekend.

items.title: Halloween Bar Crawl on Broadway
items.blurb: The Broadway-focused Halloween crawl for anyone who wants costumes and honky-tonk noise in the same evening. Sales are ending soon, tickets from $20.58.

items.title: Murder Mystery Masquerade
items.blurb: A Halloween-night murder mystery with a masquerade theme, so you get a mask, a whodunit and a room full of suspects. Tickets from $85.08.

items.title: Nashville Official Halloween Bar Crawl
items.blurb: A Halloween Saturday bar crawl that kicks off in the afternoon, so you can start early and still be upright for the evening. Tickets from $23.99.

items.title: Nashville Zombie Crawl
items.venue: Friends in Low Places Bar & Honky-Tonk
items.blurb: A two-night Halloween bar crawl covering 10+ bars, with the ticket page flagging that sales end soon. Tickets start at $19.98.

items.title: Nation's Drink-or-Treat
items.venue: The Nations, starting at Silo Market
items.blurb: A grown-up trick-or-treat route through The Nations, beginning at Silo Market in the early afternoon. Sales are ending soon.

items.title: The Apple: A Death Note Inspired Culinary Mystery Event
items.blurb: A Death Note themed culinary mystery evening at a brewery, for anime fans who also want dinner.

items.title: Joe Wagner Wine Dinner
items.blurb: Five courses, including braised short rib and Angus hanger steak, with six Joe Wagner wines poured alongside. One night only, ages 21+, and all sales are final.

items.title: Nashville Creators & Treasures Pop-Up
items.blurb: A daytime pop-up market of local creators and treasures set in the park. A Friday morning start suits anyone with a flexible schedule and gift lists to chip away at.

items.title: 2026 Fall Farm Dinner
items.blurb: Edible Nashville's seasonal farm dinner runs two nights, with tickets already live on Eventbrite. The page also asks for volunteers if you would rather work the dinner than sit at it.

items.title: Wagyu, Whiskey, and Wine
items.blurb: A steakhouse pairing night built around wagyu, whiskey and wine at Morton's, with a second date listed.

items.title: Kosher Nashville Hot Chicken & Jewish Arts & Music Festival
items.blurb: Nashville hot chicken made kosher, paired with Jewish arts and music in a single Sunday afternoon festival.

items.title: Secondhand Wedding Dress Pop Up
items.blurb: A pop-up selling secondhand wedding dresses, with the first session at noon and two more time slots listed.

items.title: Handmade Pasta Making Class with Chef Taylor
items.venue: Mary Louise's Social Club, Tempo by Hilton Nashville Downtown
items.blurb: A hands-on pasta class led by Chef Taylor in a downtown hotel social club. A second date is listed.

items.title: Tipsy Turkey Pub Crawl
items.blurb: A pre-Thanksgiving pub crawl through Printers Alley, starting mid-afternoon.

items.title: The Pasta Club: Gnocchi Night
items.blurb: A Sunday afternoon devoted to one thing, gnocchi, at a hotel studio space.

items.title: A Starlit Dinner Amongst The Stars
items.blurb: A ticketed dinner set at the Parthenon, which is reason enough to book a table at it.
